lines: Racks. Fans. Cold air. Somewhere in here is every secret GyaraCorp has.
And a desk, top left. One computer. 'GYARADB · MASTER CONTROL'.
Not yet. I came in here for that computer.
I'm not leaving now. Not halfway through.
I've done enough to that computer for one lifetime.
Yuvie: Before you start, Donnie. Administration. You lied to us that day.
Yuvie: We let it go. We've let a lot of things go today. Remember that.
Yuvie: Donnie. You're in. Good.
Yuvie: Your final task is too easy. We've sent something to your phone.
Irshad: A file. Plug the phone into the master console and upload it. It turns off the cooling and tells the fans to have a little rest.
Adi: The servers get hot. Then they get very hot. Then they get... expensive.
Donnie[worried]: And Betty?
Yuvie: Upload it, and Betty walks out of here. You have my word.
Donnie: Your word. From the people who kidnapped her.
Yuvie: It's the only word on offer, Donnie.
The console wakes up.
Just one key and it's over.
{music:the_final_query}The fans stop. The racks start ticking like an oven warming up.
Red lights. Every alarm in the building decides it's its turn.
Donnie[shocked]: ...I think I just set fire to a company.
Yuvie: Donnie. Lovely work. Really.
Yuvie: Betty's free. She's walking home as we speak.
Donnie[shocked]: She's... she's okay?
Yuvie: She's fine. Here's the thing, though. Something this big, somebody has to take the fall.
Adi: And you're the one standing next to the smoking computer.
Irshad: Sorry, Donnie. Genuinely.
Yuvie: Goodbye, Donnie.
The line goes dead.
Police: POLICE! Hands where we can see them!
CEO[angry]: Look at my servers. LOOK at them.
Liam: Hahaha! Oh, Dad. Your face.
CEO[stern]: Security found him locked in a meeting room, smelling of coffee. And now this.
Liam: Don't look at me. I was in a meeting.
CEO[angry]: You. The janitor. Do you have ANY idea what you've done?
Donnie: Yes. I got my daughter back.
CEO[angry]: Arrest him. Get him out of my building.
Yuvie: Donnie. Where are you?
Donnie: ...Still outside. Like I said.
Yuvie: No. You're in the server room.
Donnie[shocked]: How do you know that? Nobody's following me. I checked.
Yuvie: You forgot someone. That intern. Ryker.
Irshad: Dumb as a bag of mice. Very useful, though. His whole job was to make sure you did as you were told.
Adi: He's been watching your every move in secret and been reporting to us as much as he can.
Yuvie: And you were doing so well, Donnie. Right up to the last moment.
Yuvie: We'd send Ryker in to finish the job. But you're behind a locked door, and he can't work a keypad.
Yuvie: So all our work. All of it. Ruined. Because you lied. And Liam won't wait any longer.
Yuvie: You need to understand how it feels to lose a fucking contract after all that hardwork Donnie.
Donnie[shocked]: No. No, wait. I'll do it. I'll do it right now. WAIT.
{music:just_donnie}Betty[shocked]: DAD! DAD, PLEASE—
Then nothing.
Yuvie: Betty is dead. Goodbye, Donnie.
The line goes dead.
Donnie[shocked]: ...
Donnie[angry]: No.
[angry] My Betty... No. I have nothing left.
[angry] Ahhhhrgh... This fucking company i'm bringing it down to it's knees
One table. Everything this company is. DELETE it.
I don't want to read it. I want it GONE.
No. Not that. DELETE.
I'm not adding anything to this company. I'm taking it all away.
DELETE. Everything.
Not enough. ALL of it.

Every client. Every pension. Every lie they ever told. Gone.
Donnie[worried]: ...It doesn't help. It was never going to help. My betty...
Security: Hands up! Away from the console!
CEO[shocked]: What did you do? What did you DO?
Liam: Hahahaha! Dad! Dad, look at you!
CEO[stern]: Security found you locked in a meeting room, smelling of coffee. What were you doin- Ugh I'll deal with you later.
CEO[angry]: Everything. Thirty years. The whole company, everything I built. It's fucking GONE.
Liam[shocked]: ...What? Gone? I didn't ask for that much. Wait what's going on.
CEO[angry]: Arrest him. The janitor. NOW.
Donnie[worried]: Wait.
I feel like I've missed something. Something big.
Something to do with the CEO's office.
...Too late now.
Donnie[worried]: Wait.
I feel like I've missed something. Something big.
Something the kidnappers hid from me.
...Too late now.
Yuvie: Donnie. You're in. Good.
Yuvie: Your final task is too easy. We've sent a file to your phone. Upload it to the master console and the servers cook.
{music:the_man_behind_the_mop}Donnie: How about we do something else?
Yuvie: Something else?...I'm listening.
Donnie: I don't know what Liam is paying you for this job but I have something that's more than anything he can offer.

Donnie: I've got MagiCorp's database login. I can copy everything GyaraCorp has into MagiCorp. The pension funds, the fake interviews, how they make the products, every client they've got. Then wipe it here.
Donnie: GyaraCorp's stock goes through the floor. MagiCorp's goes through the roof. And you hear which way the money's moving before anyone else does.
Irshad: ...That's actually a much better idea.
Yuvie: And what do you want for it?
Donnie[angry]: Betty goes home. I go home. Tonight. And you sell out Liam.
Adi: Ooh.
Yuvie: ...Liam was milking us for pennies anyway. Fine fuck that guy.
Yuvie: Use the CEO's keycard on that console. Daddy already thinks his son is up to something. Let him finish the thought.
Irshad: Anything that still points at you, we'll point at Ryker. He won't notice. He doesn't notice things.
Yuvie: Copy it all to MagiCorp. Then delete it. All of it. Then Betty comes home.
The line goes dead.
Wait. Before I press anything.
If GyaraCorp is about to sink and MagiCorp is about to fly... my savings should be in MagiCorp first.
Phone. INFI Bank. While it's still 83p.
Shares first. INFI Bank, on my phone. Then this.
CEO keycard accepted. MagiCorp link up (ryker.v). Copy gyaradb into magicorp_inbox, then wipe gyaradb.
Not into GyaraDB's own table. Into MagiCorp's: magicorp_inbox.
That's the copy. The copy is the whole point.
Copy first. ALL of it. Then delete. That's the deal.
0 rows here. Everything, over there.
Somewhere, a MagiCorp server just got very interested in its inbox.
CEO[shocked]: No. No, no, no.
CEO[angry]: Everything. Every client, every pension, the product code, the interview programme. Copied to MagiCorp, then wiped from ours.
Liam[angry]: Your guards dragged me out of a meeting room for this? What's going on?
CEO[stern]: An executive keycard was used at the master console, four minutes ago. And the keycard was mine
Liam[shocked]: What? Your keycard. Why dad?
CEO[angry]: You idiot! You did it with my card. You were at my station with yours all night, and when I shut it off, you stole mine.
Liam[shocked]: I didn't! I was locked in a meeting room! It was Donnie!
CEO[stern]: You are a disappointment son! Security. Take him.
Liam[angry]: It's DONNIE! Not me! DONNIE!
CEO[stern]: ...
CEO: What's a Donnie?
{music:the_man_behind_the_mop}Donnie: ...
They think I'm stuck outside. Ryker's locked in an interview room. Nobody's watching me.
I bought time. For the first time today, nobody's telling me what to do.
Donnie[worried]: I could tell the CEO. Everything. He wants whoever's behind this as much as I do.
He's out on the floor somewhere. So is security.
Not this. The CEO. He's out on the floor somewhere, in the dark.
Who's there?
Liam? Is that you?
My own floor. In the dark. Unbelievable.
CEO[stern]: You. The janitor. How do you have clearance to be here?
Donnie: Sir. Please. Two minutes. Then call whoever you like.
CEO[stern]: ...Two.
Donnie: It's Liam. He's behind all this.
CEO[stern]: What?How do you know that? All I know is he used his keycard at my station.
Donnie[worried]: Because they took my daughter. Betty. Three people in a van, this morning.
Donnie[worried]: They've been calling me all day asking me to sabotage Gyaracorp. Threatening her life. I wanted to find and tell you.
Donnie[angry]: They wanted me to wreck your company. The servers, the data, all of it. And Liam is the one who hired them.
CEO[stern]: ...
CEO[stern]: My son is definitely capable of it. Especially after the scuffle yesterday.
CEO[stern]: But you're a janitor I've never met, creeping round my floor in the dark. How do I trust you?
Donnie: The small meeting room. He's locked in it. Ask him yourself.
CEO[angry]: Sit down, Liam.
Liam[angry]: Dad, this is ridiculous. A janitor locked me in a—
CEO[angry]: SIT. DOWN.
CEO[stern]: There's a girl. Betty Raymond. Where is she?
Liam: I don't know what you're talking about.
CEO[stern]: You used your card at my station tonight. Liam you know you cannot lie to me. I will know.
CEO[angry]: Where. Is. She.
Liam[shocked]: ...
Liam: ...An old print shop. Calder Street. Behind the bus depot.
Liam[angry]: They said nobody would get hurt! It was only supposed to make you look bad for like a day!
CEO[stern]: Hello. Police? Yes. There has been a kidnapping at an old print shop on Calder Street, behind the bus depot. Please rush urgently.
CEO[stern]: Also send a car to my office. For my son.
